name: hailboard-monorepo
description: A coordination layer that lets teammates' coding agents talk to each other across machines.

scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.lint:server: cd packages/server && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.lint:server:fix: cd packages/server && uv run ruff check --fix . && uv run ruff format .
scripts.server:dev: cd packages/server && DATABASE_URL=${DATABASE_URL:-postgres://hailboard:hailboard@localhost:5432/hailboard} AUTO_MIGRATE=${AUTO_MIGRATE:-true} uv run python -m hailboard_server
scripts.gen:api: cd packages/server && uv run python scripts/export_openapi.py ../protocol/openapi.json && cd ../.. && pnpm --filter @hailboard/protocol gen
